component.title: Capability gate
component.purpose: The in-thread prompt an agent raises when it needs a capability it was not granted. It states what was withheld, what would unblock it, and how long the request remains open.

states.description: A gate awaiting an owner decision, with its expiry stated.
The capability was granted once and the turn resumed.
The viewer is not the owner and cannot answer this gate.
Writing the decision failed; the gate remains open.
The decision is being retried after a transient failure.

claims.statement: The gate names the specific capability that was missing, not a generic permission error.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-009 exists so a person can make a decision; a generic error gives them nothing to decide with.

claims.statement: The remaining time before the request expires is visible without interaction.
claims.rationale: An expiring prompt that does not show its expiry surprises the owner when it disappears.

claims.statement: The dominant action grants the capability for this turn only; any broader grant is a secondary path.
claims.rationale: A one-click permanent grant is how a scoped system quietly becomes unscoped.

claims.statement: No grant control is rendered to a viewer who is not the owner.
claims.rationale: A gate discloses what was withheld, so showing it to a group would breach OT-P1-002.

claims.statement: Both decisions are reachable and operable from the keyboard alone.
A gate arriving in an open thread is announced without stealing focus from the composer.

priorities.statement: What the agent was not allowed to do
How long the request stays open
